start: A1 seed 1 step 100, original adapter, optimizer and scheduler
comparison: Both arms train the ordinary on-policy A1 objective with eight ordinary completions per prompt and identical random seed and order. Both add one identical fixed replay schedule without count hints. Replay rows must have a new one-to-one match at IoU >= .5 vs the first four draws, above-mean A1 reward, and at least one other interval. Both see the same canonical full predicted sequence. Only the directly supervised digits differ: all timestamp digits vs only newly matched timestamps. Previously found and false spans both lose auxiliary weight in the restricted arm.
loss: Per-example mean cross entropy over selected digit-containing tokens, then mean across the replay examples in that step, coefficient 0.10. The scalar auxiliary coefficient is matched; the number of tokens and gradient norms can differ. Every selected answer appears once. Entirely training-split replay bank; no GT times inserted into responses.
primary: Final checkpoint, ordinary prompt: OMTG macro tF1@0.5 rescued minus whole, source-video paired bootstrap. Replicate on hold_multi. Also compare both with ordinary A1, track precision, recall, single-event uIoU and the 90 previously unreachable events. This is a single-seed, repeatedly evaluated exploratory split.
decision: Prioritise only if rescued exceeds whole on OMTG and hold_multi, without material single-event regression; compare against ordinary A1 before pursuing. Report paired intervals.
